courses.title: Somatic Enneagram Module 3 Online (November 2026)
courses.description: A three-day Zoom training with Marion Gilbert on telling the essence of who we are apart from the defensive habits of personality. Through talks, group work and practice it looks at blind spots, fight, flight and freeze, and calming the nervous system through somatic self-awareness.
